summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MVP 3.1 Extension - Featured Image Sync Support. All 21 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI fully functional with featured image upload area in publish dialog, per-site Post Type and Status dropdowns working correctly.

issues: Console warning: Checkbox is changing from uncontrolled to controlled - minor React state management issue, does not affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug: ContentItemResponse was using ContentPublishStatus instead of ContentPublishStatusWithImage, causing featured_image field to be ignored in API responses
WordPress REST API integration is MOCKED - no real WP site connected. Featured image upload works locally but WP media sync will fail without real credentials.
File validation correctly enforces JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP only with max 5MB limit
seed_data_creation: Test content items and WordPress sites created during testing were cleaned up
context_for_next_testing_agent: MVP 3.1 Featured Image Sync fully tested. Backend APIs: POST/GET/DELETE /api/content/{id}/featured-images/{site_id}, GET /api/uploads/featured_images/{file_key}. Frontend: ContentDetailPage publish dialog shows per-site featured image upload when site is selected. Images stored in /app/backend/uploads/featured_images/. All existing MVP 3 functionality (Content Library CRUD, WordPress Sites CRUD, Multi-site Publishing) still works.
